attrs.label: SEO content for every page
attrs.html:
SEO content for every page

SEO content creation for the pages that bring you customers. Each type is written for its own job: some pages need to rank, some to sell, the best do both.

Service pages

Service pages

The pages that turn a search into an enquiry. A good service page answers what you offer, who it’s for, what it costs, how it works and why you, in the order a buyer asks those questions.

What we include

  • Keyword and intent research for each service
  • Benefits, process and pricing sections
  • Proof: results, reviews and case studies
  • FAQs with FAQPage schema
  • Clear calls to action
  • Internal links to related services

Typical length800–1,500 words

Best forBusinesses whose main pages rank on page two or don’t convert

Blog articles

Blog articles

Articles that answer the questions your customers ask before they buy, and lead them to the pages that sell. Each one targets a real search and earns its place in a topic cluster.

What we include

  • Topic and keyword chosen from your content plan
  • Answer-first intros that AI search can quote
  • Expert input from your team
  • Original examples, tables and visuals
  • Links to your service and product pages
  • Article and author schema

Typical length1,200–2,500 words

Best forBuilding traffic and trust over time

Category and product copy

Category and product copy

Category intros and product descriptions for online stores. Short, useful copy that helps people choose, and gives Google something to rank besides a grid of products.

What we include

  • Category intros above and below the product grid
  • Unique product descriptions, not the supplier’s text
  • Buying guides and size or fit help
  • Product and Offer schema details
  • Copy for filters and collections worth ranking
  • Bulk work for large catalogues

Typical length150–600 words

Best forWooCommerce and Shopify stores

Landing pages

Landing pages

Focused pages for campaigns, offers and products, written to convert visitors from ads and search. One audience, one message, one action.

What we include

  • Message matched to the ad or search
  • Headline and offer testing ideas
  • Objection handling and proof
  • Short forms and clear next steps
  • Variants for paid and organic traffic
  • Copy that passes Google Ads quality checks

Typical length600–1,200 words

Best forPaid campaigns and launches

Location pages

Location pages

Pages for each town or area you serve, with real local detail: jobs done there, local reviews, travel times and landmarks. Not the same page with the city name swapped.

What we include

  • Research into each area and its searches
  • Local proof: projects, reviews and photos
  • LocalBusiness and service-area details
  • Unique copy for every location
  • Links to your Google Business Profile
  • A template your team can extend

Typical length600–1,000 words

Best forBusinesses serving several towns or regions

Pillar pages and guides

Pillar pages and guides

In-depth guides that cover a topic fully and hold a cluster of articles together. They earn links, rank for hundreds of related searches and show real expertise.

What we include

  • Topic research and a cluster map
  • A table of contents and jump links
  • Original data, diagrams or comparisons
  • Links to and from every article in the cluster
  • Expert review and sources
  • A plan to keep it up to date

Typical length2,500–5,000 words

Best forOwning a topic in a competitive market

attrs.label: How we research and write SEO content
attrs.html:
How we research and write SEO content

Every piece starts with data and ends with data. In between: competitor research, real customer questions, your team’s expertise and a writing method built for people and search engines.

  1. 01

    SEO data first

    Search volume, difficulty and intent for every keyword, plus what your site already ranks for in Search Console, so we build on what’s working.

    Search Console · Semrush · Ahrefs

  2. 02

    Competitor insight

    We read the top ten results for each search: their structure, depth, angle and what they leave out. Your page has to be the better answer, not a copy.

    Top 10 results · content gaps

  3. 03

    Audience research

    The questions your customers actually ask, taken from “People also ask”, reviews, forums, sales calls and your support inbox.

    People also ask · reviews · your team

  4. 04

    Expertise from your team

    A short interview with the people who do the work, so the content has real examples, opinions and details no competitor can copy.

    15-minute expert calls

  5. 05

    Our writing method

    The answer first, then the detail. Short paragraphs, question headings, lists and tables where they help, in your tone of voice.

    Answer-first · scannable · on-brand

  6. 06

    Measure and refine

    We check every piece at 30, 60 and 90 days: rankings, clicks and enquiries. What’s close to page one gets improved; what isn’t working gets rethought.

    30 / 60 / 90-day reviews

Two or three versions, one winner

We don’t guess which headline works. For important pages we write two or three versions of the parts that matter most, test them with real searchers and keep the one that performs.

  • Two or three titles and meta descriptions, tested on click-through rate in Search Console
  • Different intros and angles for key pages, tested on time on page and enquiries
  • Headline and call-to-action versions on landing pages, A/B tested with real traffic
  • The winner stays; what we learn shapes the next brief

attrs.label: What SEO-friendly content really means
attrs.html:
What SEO-friendly content really means

SEO-friendly content writing isn’t stuffing keywords into a page. It’s writing that answers the search clearly, with the details people and search engines look for. The same paragraph, twice:

Before

We are a leading dental practice offering a wide range of high-quality treatments. Our experienced team is passionate about providing the very best care in a friendly and welcoming environment. Contact us today to find out more about how we can help you achieve the smile of your dreams.

Could be any dentist, anywhere. Answers nothing.

After

1A single dental implant at Harbour Dental costs from £2,400, including the crown. 2Most patients in Bristol have their consultation within a week and their implant fitted within three months. 3The price depends on whether you need a bone graft, and you can spread the cost over 12 months with 0% finance.4

Answers the search, for this clinic, in three sentences.

  1. 1
    Answers the question first

    The price is in the first sentence, where Google and AI answers look for it.

  2. 2
    Uses the searcher’s words

    “Dental implant”, “Bristol”, “consultation”: the terms people type.

  3. 3
    Specific, checkable facts

    Numbers and details, not adjectives like “leading” and “high-quality”.

  4. 4
    Links to the next step

    An internal link to finance, the question most people ask next.

attrs.label: Written by people, never by AI
attrs.html:
Written by people, never by AI

We never write content with AI. Every piece is written, proofread and edited by people. We use AI for research only, and to learn what kind of content AI search tools cite, so we know what to write.

Where people do the work

  • Writing every word in your voice
  • Adding real expertise, examples and opinions
  • Interviewing your team for details only you know
  • Proofreading, editing and fact-checking
  • Expert review and deciding what to publish

Where AI helps us: research only

  • Researching what ranks and what people ask
  • Spotting gaps against competitor pages
  • Checking which content AI answers cite
  • Learning what gets quoted in AI search, topic by topic

Google calls it E-E-A-T. We build it into every page.

  • Experience

    First-hand detail: real cases, photos and examples from your business.

  • Expertise

    Written or reviewed by people who know the subject.

  • Authority

    Author pages, credentials and links that show who’s behind it.

  • Trust

    Accurate, sourced and up to date, with clear contact details.

attrs.label: Content that AI search can quote
attrs.html:
Content that AI search can quote

Google’s AI Overviews and ChatGPT pick passages that answer a question clearly. We structure every page so yours are the ones they choose.

  1. 1

    Answer first

    A two-sentence answer straight under the heading, written to be quoted.

  2. 2

    Question headings

    H2s phrased the way people ask, so each section answers one question.

  3. 3

    Facts in tables and lists

    Prices, steps and comparisons laid out so they’re easy to lift.

  4. 4

    FAQ and Article schema

    Structured data that tells AI tools what each part of the page is.

attrs.title: SEO content writing questions, answered
attrs.lead: Can’t find your answer? Ask us on a free 30-minute call.

items.question: What are SEO content writing services?
items.answer: SEO content writing services plan, write and optimise the pages and articles on your website so they rank in Google and turn readers into customers. That includes keyword research, a brief for every piece, writing, editing, on-page SEO and tracking.

items.question: What’s the difference between SEO content writing and SEO copywriting?
items.answer: They overlap. SEO copywriting usually means pages that sell, such as service and landing pages. SEO content writing also covers articles and guides that answer questions. We do both, and most plans mix them.

items.question: How much do SEO content writing services cost?
items.answer: It depends on how many pieces you need each month and how specialist the topics are. Every plan is a fixed monthly price, quoted after a free 30-minute call.

items.question: Do you use AI to write content?
items.answer: No. We never write content with AI. Every piece is written, proofread and edited by people, and specialist topics are reviewed by an expert. We use AI only for research, and to learn what kind of content AI search tools cite.

items.question: Who writes the content?
items.answer: Specialist writers who know your industry, guided by an SEO strategist and checked by an editor. You get the same writers over time, so the voice stays consistent.

items.question: How long until new content ranks?
items.answer: Pages for less competitive searches can rank in a few weeks. Most content builds over three to six months, especially on newer sites.

items.question: Can you publish the content on our website?
items.answer: Yes. We publish in WordPress with the formatting, images, links and schema in place, or hand over ready-to-paste documents if you prefer.

items.question: Who owns the content?
items.answer: You do. Everything we write for you is yours once it’s paid for.
